(1) the pass-through from nonenergy commodity prices is significant and substantial; (2) the pass-through is asymmetric and depends on the sign of the commodity price shock; and (3) the pass-through of the exchange rate to producer prices is significant, but the pass-through of exchange rate shocks to consumer prices is insignificant. 1 1.

(i) non-energy commodity prices have a significant effect on the euro area producer price index (PPI), (ii) the pass-through from the PPI to the consumer price index (CPI) is significant and (iii) the pass-through is stronger for non-durable goods than for durables and services.
